description: Facebook & Instagram data for AI agents: pages, posts, groups, ads, Marketplace, profiles, reels.

tool_signatures.name: facebook_ads_archive_details
tool_signatures.description: Get one Ad Library ad in full: creative, body text, CTA, platforms, countries, date range, and spend and impression estimates where Meta publishes them. Needs the ad_archive_id from a facebook_ads_search result. Pricing: 1 credit per call.

tool_signatures.name: facebook_ads_countries
tool_signatures.description: List the country codes the Ads Library tools accept in their country parameter. Pricing: 1 credit per call.

tool_signatures.name: facebook_ads_keywords
tool_signatures.description: Find advertisers running ads that match a keyword: returns Facebook pages with their page_id and ad count. Use it to discover who advertises on a topic, then pass a page_id to facebook_ads_search (as ad_page_id) or facebook_ads_page_details. To get the ads for a keyword directly, use facebook_ads_search. Pricing: 1 credit per call.

tool_signatures.name: facebook_ads_page_details
tool_signatures.description: Get an advertiser\

tool_signatures.name: facebook_ads_search
tool_signatures.description: Search ads in the Meta Ad Library. Pass a keyword (query) to find ads about a topic, or ad_page_id to list one advertiser\

tool_signatures.name: facebook_download_media
tool_signatures.description: Resolve a Facebook media URL (image, video or audio, e.g. from a post or reel) to direct downloadable file URLs. Returns URLs, not file bytes. Pricing: 1 credit per call.

tool_signatures.name: facebook_get_album_items
tool_signatures.description: Get the photos and videos inside a Facebook album (from a page or a group): media_id, media_type, url, thumbnail_uri and timestamp (Unix seconds). Needs an album_id from facebook_get_page_albums or facebook_get_group_albums. Returns an end_cursor for the next page. Pricing: 1 credit per call.

tool_signatures.name: facebook_get_comment_replies
tool_signatures.description: List replies to one Facebook comment. Needs comment_feedback_id and expansion_token, which facebook_get_post_comments returns when called with include_reply_info=true. Pricing: 1 credit per call.

tool_signatures.name: facebook_get_group_albums
tool_signatures.description: List the photo albums of a public Facebook group, with album_id, album_title, url, thumbnail_uri, photos_count and videos_count. Returns an end_cursor for the next page. Needs the numeric group ID (group_id) from facebook_get_group_id. To get the photos in an album, pass its album_id to facebook_get_album_items. Pricing: 1 credit per call.

tool_signatures.name: facebook_get_group_details
tool_signatures.description: Get a public Facebook group\

tool_signatures.name: facebook_get_group_id
tool_signatures.description: Resolve a Facebook group URL to its numeric group ID. Use facebook_get_group_details for the group\

tool_signatures.name: facebook_get_group_posts
tool_signatures.description: List recent posts from a public Facebook group, with text, media, author, reactions and comment counts. Returns 3-9 posts per call plus an end_cursor for the next page; filter by date with after_time / before_time. Pricing: ceil(posts_returned / 3) credits per call, minimum 1.

tool_signatures.name: facebook_get_group_videos
tool_signatures.description: List videos posted in a public Facebook group, with video_id, title, duration, view count and thumbnail. Returns an end_cursor for the next page. Pricing: 1 credit per call.

tool_signatures.name: facebook_get_page_albums
tool_signatures.description: List the photo albums of a Facebook page, with album_id, album_title, url, thumbnail_uri and album_items_count (text, e.g.

tool_signatures.name: facebook_get_page_details
tool_signatures.description: Get a Facebook page\

tool_signatures.name: facebook_get_page_id
tool_signatures.description: Resolve a Facebook page URL to its numeric page ID. Use it when another tool needs a page or profile ID; use facebook_get_page_details for the page\

tool_signatures.name: facebook_get_page_posts
tool_signatures.description: List a Facebook page\

tool_signatures.name: facebook_get_page_reels
tool_signatures.description: List a Facebook page\

tool_signatures.name: facebook_get_page_videos
tool_signatures.description: List videos uploaded to a Facebook page, with video_id, title, duration, view count and thumbnail. Provide the page URL (link) or its numeric profile_id. Returns an end_cursor for the next page. For short-form reels, use facebook_get_page_reels. Pricing: 1 credit per call.

tool_signatures.name: facebook_get_post_attachments
tool_signatures.description: List every media attachment (images and videos, with URLs and dimensions) on a Facebook post, including all items in multi-photo posts. Needs the numeric post_id from facebook_get_post_id. For the post\

tool_signatures.name: facebook_get_post_comments
tool_signatures.description: List top-level comments on a Facebook post or reel, with author, text, timestamp and reaction count. Returns up to 30 per call plus an end_cursor for the next page. Set include_reply_info=true to get the comment_feedback_id and expansion_token that facebook_get_comment_replies needs. Pricing: 1 credit per call.

tool_signatures.name: facebook_get_post_details
tool_signatures.description: Get a Facebook post\

tool_signatures.name: facebook_get_post_details_extended
tool_signatures.description: Get everything facebook_get_post_details returns plus view counts, HD/SD video URLs, music/audio metadata and author verification status. Use it for reels and video posts, or when the standard details lack view_count, video_hd_src or attached_track. Pricing: 1 credit per call.

tool_signatures.name: facebook_get_post_id
tool_signatures.description: Extract the numeric post ID from a Facebook post URL. Use it to get the post_id that facebook_get_post_attachments needs. Pricing: 1 credit per call.

tool_signatures.name: facebook_get_video_details
tool_signatures.description: Get a Facebook video post\

tool_signatures.name: facebook_marketplace_categories
tool_signatures.description: List Marketplace categories with their IDs and category_url values. Use a category_url to filter facebook_marketplace_search. Pricing: 1 credit per call.

tool_signatures.name: facebook_marketplace_city_coordinates
tool_signatures.description: Convert a city name to the latitude and longitude that the Marketplace search tools expect in filter_location_latitude / filter_location_longitude. Pricing: 1 credit per call.

tool_signatures.name: facebook_marketplace_listing
tool_signatures.description: Get one Marketplace listing in full: title, price, description, condition, all photos, location and seller. Needs the listing_id from a Marketplace search result. Pricing: 1 credit per call.

tool_signatures.name: facebook_marketplace_rentals
tool_signatures.description: Search Facebook Marketplace rental listings (apartments, houses, rooms) near a location, with price, bedroom, bathroom and radius filters. Returns rental listings with their listing_id, plus an end_cursor. For items for sale, use facebook_marketplace_search. Pricing: 1 credit per call.

tool_signatures.name: facebook_marketplace_search
tool_signatures.description: Search general Facebook Marketplace listings (items for sale) by keyword or category near a location, with price, condition, radius and sort filters. Returns listings with their listing_id, plus an end_cursor. For cars and other vehicles use facebook_marketplace_vehicles; for homes and rooms to rent use facebook_marketplace_rentals. Get coordinates from facebook_marketplace_city_coordinates. Pricing: 1 credit per call.

tool_signatures.name: facebook_marketplace_seller
tool_signatures.description: Get a Marketplace seller\

tool_signatures.name: facebook_marketplace_vehicles
tool_signatures.description: Search Facebook Marketplace vehicle listings (cars, trucks, motorcycles) near a location, with price, radius and seller-type filters. Returns listings with title, price, mileage, year and listing_id, plus an end_cursor. For non-vehicle items, use facebook_marketplace_search. Pricing: 1 credit per call.

tool_signatures.name: facebook_search_locations
tool_signatures.description: Look up Facebook places by name (city, region, venue) and get their location_uid. The location_uid is only used to filter facebook_search_pages, facebook_search_people and facebook_search_posts; it is not a Marketplace location (use facebook_marketplace_city_coordinates for that). Pricing: 1 credit per call.

tool_signatures.name: facebook_search_pages
tool_signatures.description: Find Facebook pages by keyword (brand, business or topic name), optionally near a location. Returns page names, URLs, categories and follower counts, 3 per call, plus an end_cursor. Use it when you don\

tool_signatures.name: facebook_search_people
tool_signatures.description: Find public Facebook profiles by name or keyword, optionally near a location (location_uid from facebook_search_locations). Returns names, profile URLs and pictures, plus work, education and location where public, and an end_cursor. Pricing: 1 credit per call.

tool_signatures.name: facebook_search_posts
tool_signatures.description: Search public Facebook posts by keyword, optionally filtered by location (location_uid from facebook_search_locations) and date range. Returns posts with text, author and engagement, plus an end_cursor. To list one page\

tool_signatures.name: facebook_search_videos
tool_signatures.description: Search public Facebook videos by keyword, optionally most recent first or live videos only. Returns video titles, URLs and view counts, plus an end_cursor. Pricing: 1 credit per call.

tool_signatures.name: instagram_get_highlight_details
tool_signatures.description: Get the stories inside one Instagram highlight. Needs a highlight_id from instagram_get_profile_highlights. Pricing: 1 credit per call.

tool_signatures.name: instagram_get_location_posts
tool_signatures.description: List Instagram posts tagged at a location: top posts (tab=ranked) or most recent (tab=recent). Needs a location_id, e.g. from a place in instagram_popular_search. Returns an end_cursor for the next page. Pricing: 1 credit per call.

tool_signatures.name: instagram_get_nearby_locations
tool_signatures.description: List Instagram places near a given location, with name, category, coordinates and post count. Needs a location_id, e.g. from a place in instagram_popular_search. Pricing: 1 credit per call.

tool_signatures.name: instagram_get_post_details
tool_signatures.description: Get one Instagram post or reel in full: caption, media URLs, engagement counts, timestamp and owner. Needs the shortcode (the part after /p/ or /reel/ in the URL, or from instagram_get_post_id). Pricing: 1 credit per call.

tool_signatures.name: instagram_get_post_id
tool_signatures.description: Extract the shortcode from an Instagram post or reel URL. instagram_get_post_details needs the shortcode. Pricing: 1 credit per call.

tool_signatures.name: instagram_get_profile_details
tool_signatures.description: Get an Instagram profile by username: bio, follower and post counts, verification status and related profiles. Pricing: 1 credit per call.

tool_signatures.name: instagram_get_profile_highlights
tool_signatures.description: List an Instagram profile\

tool_signatures.name: instagram_get_profile_posts
tool_signatures.description: List an Instagram profile\

tool_signatures.name: instagram_get_profile_reels
tool_signatures.description: List an Instagram profile\

tool_signatures.name: instagram_get_reels_by_audio
tool_signatures.description: List Instagram reels that use a given sound. Needs the audio_id (music/audio cluster ID) found in reel results\

tool_signatures.name: instagram_get_reels_feed
tool_signatures.description: Get Instagram\

tool_signatures.name: instagram_get_user_id
tool_signatures.description: Resolve an Instagram username or profile URL to its two IDs: user_id (long, e.g. 17841401474538262), used by instagram_get_profile_posts and instagram_get_profile_reels, and pk (short, e.g. 528817151), used by instagram_get_profile_highlights. Pricing: 1 credit per call.

tool_signatures.name: instagram_popular_search
tool_signatures.description: Search Instagram by keyword and get the top matching users, hashtags and places. Use it to find a username, or a place\
